result.description: A fictional 27-inch curved office monitor designed for writing, spreadsheets, and long-form reading. It uses a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel, 75 Hz refresh rate, USB-C input with 65W power delivery, dual HDMI ports, and an integrated blue-light reduction mode. The slim matte enclosure and adjustable stand make it suited to compact desks and multi-monitor workspaces.
